title: Safely degrade: tenant-aware queueing + admission prototype
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Prototype and validate a tenant-aware load-shedding subsystem combining priority queueing, admission control tweaks, and graceful degradation modes. Goal: keep tail-latency SLOs for P0/P1 tenants during multi-region overloads while preserving best-effort progress for lower tiers and minimizing error surface. Deliverables: design doc, simulation harness, POC admission controller, runtime flags, and an operator playbook.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Simulation shows >=95% P0 success under synthetic regional spike with <100ms median added latency. 2) Admission controller can downscale response fidelity (truncate generation depth, compress payloads, or route to fallback model) per-tenant config. 3) Observable signal emitted for every degraded request (metric + trace tag). 4) Runbook for oncall describing promotion/demotion and manual overrides.
comments: 2026-02-18 - Aisha Patel: Ticket created. Ran quick spike to reproduce tenant prioritization gaps observed during last regional failover incident. Baseline: P0 tail latencies spike by 3x when region saturated.

2026-02-22 - Marco Nguyen: Draft design uploaded to Confluence. Key idea: maintain fast-path lane (for P0) with small token budget + heavy-prefetching; soft-credits for P1; graceful degradation pipeline attached to admission decision. See design_links.

2026-02-25 - Elena Rossi (review): Suggested we prefer probabilistic admission for P2 to avoid synchronized drops. Also asked for explicit metrics for "degraded_response" and "fallback_model_used". Added to acceptance_criteria.

2026-03-03 - Marco Nguyen: Ran 10K-req synthetic test across us-east/us-west regions using the simulator. Results: P0 success at 92% (goal 95%). Observed queue head-of-line blocking from long-running requests in P1 lane. Decided to implement preemptive requeue and max-queue-age eviction.

2026-03-05 - Marco Nguyen: Implemented admission controller POC (github PR #7421). Features: token-bucket per-tenant, probabilistic early-reject for lowest tier, and a degrade pipeline that can: 1) decrease generation max_tokens, 2) switch to a quantized fallback model, 3) return partial content with "continued":true meta. Added trace tags for "shed_level".

2026-03-07 - QA (Sofia Kim): Integration testing uncovered an edge-case where streaming sessions aborted mid-degradation causing client-side parse errors. Proposed change: emit a deterministic end-of-stream envelope for degraded responses. Added task to PR.

2026-03-09 - Security (Rahul Mehta): Reviewed risk surface for fallback model usage (data residency concerns for Private deployments). Recommendation: add per-tenant policy to forbid cross-region fallback. Marked security_review_required=false but flagged for follow-up in Private rollouts.

2026-03-10 - Marco Nguyen: Updated simulation with preemptive requeue and max-queue-age. New run: P0 success 96%, P1 degraded at acceptable rates; CPU utilization on serving nodes increased by ~4%. Preparing runbook draft and scheduling design review on 2026-03-12.
2026-03-10 - Aisha Patel: PM feedback - ensure admin override API is simple (one call to promote tenant out of shedding) and logged for audit. Added admin_override to work items.
